dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive myoclonus–ataxia syndrome, most consistent with sporadic adult-onset cerebellar ataxia with myoclonus of currently unknown cause

ALTERNATIVE 1: Early sporadic Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease

ALTERNATIVE 2: Genetic progressive myoclonic ataxia, such as a spinocerebellar ataxia or neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis

ALTERNATIVE 3: Autoimmune or paraneoplastic cerebellar ataxia with myoclonus
